name: leather bracers
_design_note: F1-25 light arms slot. Oil-hardened leather forearm guards. Bracers_of_Cu_Chulainn uses this as template_basis.
lore_template: A pair of {material_name} bracers, strapped from wrist to elbow over the tendons a glancing blade finds first. Archers wear the same thing for a humbler reason: the slap of the bowstring.
